scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns singular spectra of bounded generalized Foguel operators on complex Hilbert spaces with isometric diagonals, not spectra of their nonnormal matrices.
The essential spectrum is the Fredholm convention; continuous spectrum and singular-value point multiplicities are distinguished.
The numerical checker tests only finite matrices and does not establish universal identities or publication priority.
The formulas for nonexceptional spectral points and the scalar reciprocal map have earlier precedents in Garcia (2009) and Raghupathi (2012).
title: A complete singular spectral normal form for generalized Foguel operators
